title: Evaluating time-to-event forecasts under fixed-horizon right-censoring
summary: Time-to-event forecasts frequently arise in applications with finite prediction or decision horizons, including in operational meteorology, hydrology, warranty analysis and insurance. In such settings, forecasts, observations, or both may only be available through their right-censored values relative to a common fixed censoring time. This article develops a framework for evaluating such forecasts.
